# generator: tools/gen_oracle.cjs (+ scenarios.cjs, scenarios_more.cjs) of the L04-L leaf (never shipped to the repo); node vm over the verbatim baseline functions
# JS values: u=undefined, n=null, else 16 hex digits of the IEEE-754 bits (NaN canonical 7ff8000000000000)
# scn NAME ; cfg entry=rendered|direct|effectors host= edit= three_d= frame= cw= ch= can_resample= span=START/LEN|- big= ;
#   rendered = getEffectiveStrokesRendered(hostIdx, frame) (span = layerInPoint / layerOutPoint - in + 1), direct = applyLayerDuplicator(ld, base, frame, null, opts),
#   effectors = window.SMEffectorLayer.resolvedEffectorsFor(hostLd, frame)
# dupj JSON|- = the host ld.duplicator as handed in (every number is "@" + bit pattern) ; - means the host has no duplicator
# lay UID dup=0|1 eff=0|1 vis=u|0|1 tgt=UID|- pos=X,Y|- fall=LABEL|-   : state.layers in order (an effector layer has eff=1 and its ld.effector)
# mv UID KEY V0/V1.. | null : what SMMotion.valueAtFrame(ld, KEY) returned (e = empty array) ; mm UID DX DY | - : what layerMotionAt returned (- = null)
# st UID FRAME LIST : getEffectiveStrokes(layer, frame) answers ; base LIST = the host content at the frame ; pl M UID | V UID KEY | S UID FRAME | H UID : distinct port calls, first-call order
# stroke token ID/FILL/C/SEGS ; SEGS = seg;seg or - ; seg = point.x:point.y:handleIn.x:handleIn.y:handleOut.x:handleOut.y (bits) ; output token = stroke token + /OPACITY/DUPINDEX/CLONEID/DUP3D
# log K PIVOTX PIVOTY DX DY ROT SX SY OPACITYFACTOR HUEDEG DUP3D|- : the placement descriptor the verbatim _duplicatorClonePlacement returned for clone K
# out same (the base came back) | out LIST | out big N FIRST LAST (capped counts) | out throws (the baseline raised a TypeError) ; effs = resolvedEffectorsFor list: X/Y,KIND,RADIUS,STRENGTH,ANGLE,CHANNELS
scn ef_none
cfg entry=effectors host=host edit=0 three_d=0 frame=401c000000000000 cw=409e000000000000 ch=4090e00000000000 can_resample=0 span=- big=0
dupj {}
lay host dup=1 eff=0 vis=u tgt=- pos=- fall=-
base -
effs e
end
